testCases.label: Verify factorial of zero returns 1
testCases.description: Checks that calling factorial(0) returns 1, as defined by mathematical convention.

testCases.label: Verify factorial works for positive integers
testCases.description: Ensures factorial returns correct values for inputs 5, 4, and 3—specifically 120, 24, and 6.

testCases.label: Verify factorial raises error for negative input
testCases.description: Checks that calling factorial with a negative number raises a ValueError.
